title: How to troubleshoot delayed or missing OTP SMS
body:
If your clients report that they are not receiving OTP SMS, please follow these steps:

1. Verify Mobile Operator DLR Status:
Check the delivery receipt in your SMS logs. Look for error codes such as EXPIRED, UNDELIVERED, or REJECTED.

2. DND (Do Not Disturb) Filtering:
Ensure the recipient number is not enrolled in an active operator DND or promotional blocker list.

3. Routing & Sender ID:
Verify that your Masking or Non-Masking Sender ID has been approved by the telecommunication regulatory authority and telecommunication operators.

4. Opening an Urgent Ticket:
If OTP issues persist across multiple numbers, please open a ticket under the 'SMS Delivery & Routing' category with affected recipient numbers and timestamps.

title: How to open and track a technical support ticket
body:
Opening a support ticket is the fastest way to get assistance from our engineering and support agents.

1. Click on 'New Ticket' or navigate to 'Tickets' -> 'New'.
2. Enter a descriptive Subject and detailed explanation of the issue.
3. Choose the appropriate Category and Department to ensure routing to the right engineering team.
4. Attach screenshots, error payloads, or logs.
5. Click 'Create Ticket'. You will receive a unique ticket ID (e.g., TK-1001) which you can track anytime.

title: Understanding SMS delivery receipts and DLR status codes
body:
When an SMS is submitted via our REST API or portal, the carrier sends back status updates:

- DELIVRD: The handset received the SMS message.
- ACCEPTD: The telecom operator gateway accepted the message for delivery.
- EXPIRED: The handset was switched off or out of coverage during the validity period.
- UNDELIV: Handset barred or invalid subscriber destination.
